description: Error tracking settings. Frappe v16 starts Sentry only from these environment variables. The receiver is a self-hosted GlitchTip (G-113). Values live only on the server, never in the repository.

environment.name: FRAPPE_SENTRY_DSN
environment.where: tenant.env on the server, or Release Group environment_variables in Press

environment.name: SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT
environment.where: same file, set to the environment name: alpha, beta, rc or prod

environment.name: SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE
environment.where: same file, a number from 0 to 1; start with 0

press_setting: Press Settings.agent_sentry_dsn for the Press agent
not_sent_to: marketing tools; X-Request-Id stays in logs and traces only
